settings.headline:
One night. One cause.
A city that shows up.
settings.copy: The Gilded Gala is the city's signature black-tie fundraiser — an evening of dinner, live auction, and music that raises real money for the families who need it most. Every ticket, every paddle, every toast goes straight to our community programs.

trust_list.text: 100% of proceeds fund local family-support programs
Three-course dinner by Chef Amara Osei
Black-tie, but warm — come as you are, dressed up

settings.eyebrow: The Gilded Gala by the numbers
settings.title: A night that
settings.intro: We don't host a gala for the sake of a gala. We host it because the numbers move the needle for real families.

settings.title: More than
settings.intro: A gala is only as good as what it funds. Here's what your ticket and your paddle make possible.

features.title: Family support programs
features.text: Emergency housing, food security, and after-school care for families navigating hard seasons.

features.title: Youth mentorship
features.text: One-to-one mentoring that pairs young people with adults who show up, week after week.

features.title: Health & wellness access
features.text: Free clinics, mental-health support, and wellness check-ins for those who can't afford care.

features.title: Every dollar accounted for
features.text: We publish an annual impact report. You'll see exactly where every gift lands.

settings.title: The ballroom opens
settings.expired_text: The Gilded Gala is on! Head to the Grand Ballroom at The Meridian Hotel — doors are open and the toasts are pouring.

settings.intro: A look at the toasts, the paddles, and the dancing that made last year's gala one for the books.

settings.title: What guests
settings.intro: We've been doing this for fourteen years, and the best part is still hearing people talk about the night — and the difference it made.

reviews.quote: I've been to a lot of fundraisers, and this is the one that actually feels like a party. The auction is electric, the dinner is incredible, and you leave knowing exactly what your money did.
reviews.author: Elena V.

reviews.quote: As a sponsor, this is the best-run gala we support all year. The team is meticulous, the impact reporting is honest, and our guests genuinely look forward to it.
reviews.author: Marcus T.

reviews.quote: Came for the cause, stayed for the dancing. The live auction alone is worth the ticket — I won a weekend away and funded a family's housing for a month.
reviews.author: Priya S.

settings.title: Questions,
settings.intro: Want to reserve a table, donate an auction item, or sponsor the gala? We'd love to talk. Reach out and we'll get back to you within a day.
